readings: Considering only payments whose rental_id is not null, group by the staff member who recorded the payment (payment.staff_id). Show that staff ID, the sum of payment.amount, and that sum divided by the total payment.amount across all such linked payments. No rounding.

Considering only payments whose rental_id is not null, join each payment to its rental and group by the staff member who handled the rental (rental.staff_id). This can differ from the staff member who recorded the payment. Show that staff ID, the sum of payment.amount, and that sum divided by the total payment.amount across all such linked payments. No rounding.
queries:
SELECT staff_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, SUM(amount) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payment WHERE rental_id IS NOT NULL) AS fraction
FROM payment
WHERE rental_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY staff_id

SELECT r.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, SUM(p.amount) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(p2.amount) FROM payment p2 JOIN rental r2 ON p2.rental_id = r2.rental_id WHERE p2.rental_id IS NOT NULL) AS share
FROM payment p
JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.staff_id
